column1: # Di Teodoro, Posti, Ogle, Fraternali & Marasco 2023, MNRAS 518, 6340 (arXiv:2207.02906): the HI rotation curves of the 15 massive spirals, panel (c) of each atlas figure
# (images/atlas/<NAME>_all.pdf in the arXiv source, e-print 10,509,160 bytes, sha256 0fde3002bc6ca69d...).  The paper does NOT tabulate the curves ('shared on reasonable request');
# these points were read from the atlas PDFs' VECTOR coordinates (each plotted point's marker position), calibrated on the axis tick labels with zero residual, so they are
# the plotted values to the figure's own precision (R to ~0.1 kpc, V to < 1 km/s).  Extraction scripts: real_research/data/diteodoro2023_extraction/.
# Validation (CFG41 control C2): applying Lelli, McGaugh & Schombert 2016's flat-part algorithm (eqs 1-2) to these points reproduces the paper's tabulated v_flat within 3 km/s
# for 12 of 15 galaxies; the other three (NGC1324, NGC5790, UGC02849) are still declining at the last point and the paper's v_flat equals the outermost point.
# Columns: name; R_kpc (galactocentric radius, kpc, the paper's distances); V_kms (deprojected HI rotation speed); dV_kms (half-length of the plotted vertical error bar, which per the
# paper includes systematic uncertainties on inclination, systemic velocity and the centre).  The H-alpha (MaNGA/CALIFA) inner points are NOT included.
# Fetched with the owner's approval for campaign_fresh_gravity CFG41.
